-85.78445,42.20948.name: Charles River Laboratories - Mattawan
-85.78445,42.20948.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Charles River Laboratories International, Inc.. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-101.33708,20.75719.name: CERH - Centro para el Estudio de la ReproducciÃ³n Humana MÃ©xico Irapuato
-101.33708,20.75719.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere. No street address resolved, so this point is the city or the country rather than the centre.

-97.16332,49.90870.name: National Microbiology Laboratory (NML)
-97.16332,49.90870.desc: A BSL4 animal laboratory, operational. Run by Public Health Agency of Canada. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 185 SqM. Operational or announced: 1999. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.
